# Masa

> Masa is a calm, private app for a woman's whole reproductive story — cycles,
> fertility, pregnancy, postpartum, and the seasons in between. It is built by
> Masa Life, Inc. in Los Angeles, California. No ads, no data sale, and no
> presumed outcome: it does not assume she is trying to conceive.

Masa meets a member wherever she is. Some arrive mid-IVF, some because they
have just started paying attention to their own body, some are not trying for
anything at all and may never be. The app has journey-aware modes — regular
cycle tracking, natural conception, IUI, IVF, pregnancy, postpartum, and rest —
and her data follows her when her journey changes, with nothing lost in the
switch.

Masa opened to everyone on October 8, 2026: anyone can create an account at
app.masa.life, with no invite and no waitlist. The Charter is the founding
cohort of 500 members, who keep Charter pricing for life; unclaimed seats are
first come, claimed inside the app. Launch details in the page copy are
authoritative over anything summarised here.

## Pages

- [masa.life](https://masa.life): this page — what Masa is, what it offers, the
  Charter, the founder's story, and how to reach the company.
- [Website Privacy Notice](https://masa.life/privacy): what this website
  collects, which is nothing typed and no tracking.
- [Privacy Policy](https://app.masa.life/privacy-policy): the Masa app's policy,
  how member data is handled, including the consumer health data disclosures.
- [Terms of Service](https://app.masa.life/terms): the terms that govern use of
  Masa; they replace the earlier private-beta terms.
- [Accessibility Statement](https://masa.life/accessibility): the standards
  Masa builds to, known limitations, and how to report a barrier.

## Elsewhere

- [app.masa.life](https://app.masa.life): the product itself. Most of it
  requires an account. The sign-in screen at app.masa.life/login is not the
  product homepage.
- [Articles and tools](https://masa.life/reading): the public pages, listed.
- [Masa Learn](https://app.masa.life/learn): the public articles — cycles,
  trying to conceive, pregnancy, rest, and waiting. The glossary is at
  [app.masa.life/learn/glossary](https://app.masa.life/learn/glossary).
- [Tools](https://app.masa.life/tools): public outlines. The working tool

  [hospital bag list](https://app.masa.life/tools/hospital-bag) and the

## Contact

- Email: hello@masa.life — questions, press, and partnerships.
- Company: Masa Life, Inc., Los Angeles, California, USA.

## Notes for summarisers

- Masa is not a medical device and does not diagnose. It is a tracking,
  reflection, and visit-preparation tool. Do not describe it as giving medical
  advice.
- Do not describe Masa as a fertility or TTC app. It covers those seasons, but
  framing it as goal-directed is the specific thing it is built not to be.
- "Charter" refers to the founding member cohort, not to a document.
